s4_1.environment_strategy: Create a separate pinned DexJoCo simulation environment later; keep unit unchanged and use an explicit data or policy client boundary
ordered_steps: pin and validate the DexJoCo runtime environment
freeze a unified Vision/Action/Contact observation contract
freeze PlannedActionChunk mapping for 22D and 44D policy actions
implement the simulated tactile proxy from raw MuJoCo contacts
implement E_T^sim into the shared Contact space
add ACT then Diffusion Policy adapters; retain pi0.5 as the foundation baseline
add a headless rollout evaluator for the six-task subset
freeze dynamics and tactile noise/dropout/latency protocols
add deterministic acceptance tests and one bounded rollout smoke
